name: My Toes Story
source:
In My Toes Story, you play as a salaryman in his 20s, trying to survive under the command of your boss. Between long days at the office and the struggles of everyday life, you meet a cast of unique waifus, each with their own charm.

But you carry a secret: Your love for feet.

As your relationships grow, find the courage to open up, and see where love and honesty might lead you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989910/My_Toes_Story/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《我的脚趾故事》中，你扮演一名20多岁的工薪族，在老板的指挥下努力生存。在漫长的办公室工作和日常生活的挣扎之间，你会遇到一群独特的女人，每个人都有自己的魅力。

但你有一个秘密：你对脚的热爱。

随着你们的关系不断发展，鼓起勇气敞开心扉，看看爱和诚实会带你走向何方。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989910/My_Toes_Story/]Steam[/url]]
